originality.rationale: Nearest priors substantively anticipate all mathematical facts. KnotAtlas/KnotTheory (precomputed PD4Knots/Jones4Knots, IndianaData, DTCode data) already publishes for every row the same PD, DT, Jones, hyperbolic volume/tag, Khovanov (r,j) support and 'Similar Knots' lists. Live pages verify: 5_1 page lists Same Jones (up to mirror) {10_132} and Same Alexander {10_132}; 10_132 page lists Same {5_1}; Jones/volume/Khovanov values identical to candidate's table. Candidate's Jones values match oracle exactly by design (calibrated on 3_1/4_1/5_2 then required to match), method is textbook Kauffman bracket state sum (Kauffman 1987), and volume/width columns are parsed — not recomputed — oracle values with trivial delta formula. The 7 collision classes and 5_1/10_132 separation (same Jones, different volume/support) are thus database joins, not new discoveries. Hoste-Thistlethwaite-Weeks (1.7M knots through 16 crossings) anticipates DT+volume census; Wehrli (math/0301312) and Morton-Ryder (0708.0514) anticipate same-Jones/different-Khovanov mutant phenomena. Claimed delta of 'joint replayable table with logs' is curation/verification engineering, not a new object, theorem, or value. A timestamp or internal prior-scan PASS does not establish priority.

value.rationale: Not independently worth finding later. Correct but textbook restatement: standard bracket enumeration applied to known census reproducing KnotAtlas exactly, joined with published volume and support-width columns. No new invariant value, no new collision (all 7 pre-listed in oracle), no Conway/KT mutant separation (explicitly not computed), no triangulation volume, no Bar-Natan homology (torsion/differentials unverified, reduced-vs-unreduced unaddressed, w=3-vs-2 convention relabeling). Star witness 5_1 (torus, non-hyperbolic) vs 10_132 (hyperbolic, wide) is readable directly from oracle pages; six other pairs are same-width volume differences only. Teaching-dataset/replay-benchmark utility does not meet publishable-research bar and falls under rejected categories: textbook restatement, database quotation with verification, and unexplained enumeration.
